<thought>Search the template catalog for a Diels‑Alder retrosynthetic transformation. In the forward Diels‑Alder reaction two C=C double bonds are converted into two C‑C single bonds, so the bond order changes from double to single. I will query for templates where a double bond order changes to single bond order.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "COC([C@]12CC=CC[C@H]1C(C2)=O)=O",
  "bonds_order_changed": ["C=C (2.0->1.0)"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
